beneficiary: A small university scientific-instrument sharing facility (prospective public design case; no agreement with a facility).
mission: A shared mobile instrument repeatedly moves between teaching, metrology and observational-science teams. Handoffs consume scarce bench time and recipients often cannot decide whether to trust or reuse a previous setup. Invent up to five materially different capabilities that could make a useful next experiment or handoff attainable. Go beyond a list of public technologies. A new arrangement, test or direct conventional route is welcome. Fewer or no opportunities are acceptable.
authority: Offline design and public-source preparation only. Real usage, facility conditions, owner participation, price and economic advantage are unknown. No remote execution, purchase, fabrication or observing-time allocation.
